param_output_item.param_description: An n-by-dims matrix of quasi-random points in [0, 1).

description.p: Generate a Halton low-discrepancy (quasi-random) sequence. The points fill space far more evenly than independent uniform draws, which makes them excellent for sampling, quasi-Monte-Carlo integration and jittered placement. Each dimension uses the radical inverse in a distinct prime base.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: P = tessera.halton(500, 2); plot(P(:, 1), P(:, 2), '.'); axis square
